aiSummary.summary: The US State Department is offering a $10 million bounty for information on Zhang Yu, a 44-year-old Chinese national allegedly linked to the state-sponsored hacking group Hafnium. Zhang is accused of playing a key role in the major Microsoft Exchange Server cyberattacks.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: This bounty highlights international efforts to hold state-sponsored cybercriminals accountable for large-scale attacks on critical enterprise infrastructure.
aiSummary.action: Report any information regarding the whereabouts of the named suspect to the US State Department.
